'''OOM-87''', also known as '''OOM87''', was a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] which reported to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] during the [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|Second battle of Florrum]]. It was sliced in half by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Youngling]] [[Petro/Legends|Petro]] during the report.
